findings.passage: "The House of Representatives passing the SAVE [America] Act by a very narrow margin is going to cost America," said Sen. Cantwell.
findings.note: Quoted in her own press release about a Feb. 19, 2026 event in Seattle. She says the Senate should not pass the SAVE America Act, which the release describes as requiring a passport or birth certificate, in person, to register or change a registration. Release posted 2026-02-20; event date used.

findings.passage: “Yesterday, we voted down yet another bill that would attack voting rights and vote-by-mail. Republicans used a weak, loophole-filled anti-corruption bill as a Trojan Horse in order to shove through extreme new voter ID rules that would interfere with mail-in voting and disenfranchise Americans, particularly tribal members and students.”
findings.note: Statement issued in her name after the Senate vote of Sept. 30, 2026 on an ethics and stock-trading bill that carried voter ID provisions. She voted against it and says the voter ID rules would affect mail-in voting, tribal members and students.
subjects: voter ID attached to unrelated bill

findings.passage: “The Department should immediately discontinue the SAVE program’s use for these illegal and non-statutory purposes and take no steps pursuant to the Executive Order that violate the law and risk disenfranchising eligible voters,”
findings.note: Closing line of a letter to DHS that she joined with 27 other senators. The letter objects to using the federal SAVE citizenship-check database for voter-roll maintenance under a March 31 executive order, citing wrongly flagged citizens. Release dated 2026-05-01; the letter itself is undated on the page.
